scripts.render: podman build -q -t ccs-render -f deploy/Containerfile.render deploy >/dev/null && mkdir -p .render-cache && podman run --rm --network=none -v "$PWD":/w:ro,z -v "$PWD/dist":/w/dist:z -v "$PWD/.render-cache":/w/.render-cache:z -w /w ccs-render python3 -B deploy/render/render.py example-data dist/templates dist .render-cache
scripts.preview: pnpm build && pnpm render && podman run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:4321:4321 -v "$PWD/dist":/srv:ro,z ccs-render python3 -m http.server 4321 -d /srv
